id.description:
Unique identifier for the timer session.

This UUID identifies the specific timer session and is used to reference it in subsequent operations such as updating or stopping the timer.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_time_track_timers.id. Primary key uniquely identifying the timer session.

started_at.description:
Timestamp marking when the timer session began.

This field is set automatically when the timer is started and serves as the reference point for calculating elapsed time. The duration is calculated by subtracting started_at from the current time when the timer is stopped, rounded to the nearest minute for the resulting timelog.
started_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_time_track_timers.started_at. Timestamp when the timer session began, set automatically when timer is created.

description.description:
Optional description of the work being performed during this timer session.

Employees can use this field to note what specific work is being done, providing context for the time being tracked. This description can be edited while the timer is running, allowing corrections and updates to work context without stopping the timer session.
description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_time_track_timers.description. Nullable field for optional work notes describing what is being tracked.

is_active.description:
Flag indicating whether this timer session is currently active.

This field distinguishes between active timers (is_active = true) and inactive timers (is_active = false). The system enforces that each employee can have at most one active timer at any time through a unique constraint on (hrm_time_track_employee_id, is_active).
is_active.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_time_track_timers.is_active. Boolean flag indicating whether this timer session is currently running.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when this timer record was created in the database.

This field is automatically set when the timer session is started and provides an audit trail of when the timer was initiated. It should match or be very close to the started_at timestamp.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_time_track_timers.created_at. Timestamp when this timer record was created in the database.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when this timer record was last modified.

This field is updated whenever the timer's description, project, or task assignment is edited while the timer is running. It provides visibility into when changes were made to the timer session context.
updated_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_time_track_timers.updated_at. Timestamp when this timer record was last modified.

employee.description:
The employee who owns this timer session.

This nested object provides the employee's identifying information including their user identity (name, email), position, department, role, employment type, and status within the organization. The employee must be assigned to the project associated with this timer.
employee.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping via JOIN on hrm_time_track_employee_id to hrm_time_track_employees table. Returns IHrmTimeTrackEmployee.ISummary with employee identity and organizational context.

project.description:
The project this timer is tracking time against.

This nested object provides the project's identifying information including name, description, color code, lifecycle status, budget hours, and planned dates. Project association is required when starting a timer, and the employee must be assigned to this project through hrm_time_track_project_members.
project.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping via JOIN on hrm_time_track_project_id to hrm_time_track_projects table. Returns IHrmTimeTrackProject.ISummary with project identification and status information.

task.description:
The optional task within the project this timer is tracking.

This nested object (or null) provides the task's identifying information including title, priority, status, and relationships. Task association is optional when starting a timer. If specified, the task must belong to the project referenced in this timer, and the employee should have access to this task.
task.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping via LEFT JOIN on hrm_time_track_task_id to hrm_time_track_tasks table. Returns IHrmTimeTrackTask.ISummary or null. Task association is optional when starting a timer.

IHrmTimeTrackTimer.description:
Complete timer session entity representing an active or completed time tracking session.

The timer captures the start timestamp, optional work description, and active status. It is associated with an employee (owner), a required project, and optionally a task within that project. The timer continues running until explicitly stopped (creating a timelog) or discarded (no timelog created).

Nested relationships provide complete context about the work being tracked: employee information shows who is tracking time, project details identify the work container, and task assignment (if present) specifies the granular work item. Timestamps indicate when the timer was started and last modified.
IHrmTimeTrackTimer.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_time_track_timers table for scalar fields: id, started_at, description, is_active, created_at, updated_at. Relations exposed as nested objects: employee via JOIN on hrm_time_track_employee_id to hrm_time_track_employees (returns IHrmTimeTrackEmployee.ISummary), project via JOIN on hrm_time_track_project_id to hrm_time_track_projects (returns IHrmTimeTrackProject.ISummary), task via LEFT JOIN on hrm_time_track_task_id to hrm_time_track_tasks (returns IHrmTimeTrackTask.ISummary or null). FK columns (hrm_time_track_employee_id, hrm_time_track_project_id, hrm_time_track_task_id) are not exposed directly as they are represented by their corresponding object relations. The snapshots relation (has-many) is excluded as it's a composition accessed through a separate endpoint.

activeTasks.description:
List of active tasks assigned to the employee, including open and in-progress tasks.

Tasks are ordered by priority (highest first) and creation date (earliest first) to help the employee focus on urgent work. Only tasks with status 'open' or 'in-progress' are included. Completed, cancelled, or deleted tasks are excluded.

The list may be empty if the employee has no active tasks assigned.
activeTasks.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_time_track_tasks via JOIN on authenticated employee.id. Filter: status IN ('open', 'in-progress'), deleted_at IS NULL. Order by priority DESC, created_at ASC. Returns array of IHrmTimeTrackTask.ISummary objects. Empty array if no active tasks exist.

currentTimesheet.description:
The timesheet for the current week (Monday-Sunday), or null if no timesheet exists yet.

This field shows the employee's timesheet for the current week including its approval status (draft, submitted, approved, or rejected) and total hours logged. If the employee has not created a timesheet for this week, this field is null.

Timesheets in 'draft' status can be modified. 'Submitted' timesheets are pending approval. 'Approved' timesheets are locked and cannot be changed. 'Rejected' timesheets can be edited and resubmitted.
currentTimesheet.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_time_track_timesheets via LEFT JOIN on authenticated employee.id AND week_start_date = current week Monday. Returns IHrmTimeTrackTimesheet.ISummary if exists, null if no timesheet for current week. Week boundaries: Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59 in organization timezone.

employee.description:
The authenticated employee's record showing identity, position, department, and role within the current organization.

This field provides the employee's core information including their user identity (name, email from member relation), job title, department assignment, role assignment, employment type (full-time, part-time, contractor, intern), and employment status (active, on leave, terminated).

For users belonging to multiple organizations, this shows the employee record for the currently selected organization context.
employee.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_time_track_employees via JOIN on authenticated employee.id from JWT session. Returns IHrmTimeTrackEmployee.ISummary with employee identity, position, department, role, employment type, and status. Organization context from session ensures correct employee record is retrieved for multi-organization users.

projectMemberships.description:
List of active projects the employee is assigned to, including project details and the employee's role on each project.

Each project membership shows the project name, status, color code, and the employee's assigned role (member or project-lead). Only projects with status 'active' are included. Archived or completed projects are excluded.

The list may be empty if the employee is not assigned to any active projects.
projectMemberships.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_time_track_project_members via JOIN on authenticated employee.id. Filter: deleted_at IS NULL, project.status = 'active'. Returns array of IHrmTimeTrackProjectMember.ISummary objects including project details and assigned role. Empty array if no active project memberships.

recentTimelogs.description:
Time entries logged by the employee during the current week (Monday-Sunday).

Each timelog shows the date, duration, billable status, notes, and associated project and task. Timelogs are ordered by date with most recent first. Only timelogs within the current week boundaries are included.

The list may be empty if the employee has not logged any time entries this week.
recentTimelogs.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_time_track_timelogs via JOIN on authenticated employee.id. Filter: date >= current week Monday AND date <= current week Sunday, deleted_at IS NULL. Returns array of IHrmTimeTrackTimelog.ISummary objects ordered by date DESC. Empty array if no timelogs in current week.

statistics.description:
Summary statistics providing quick insights into the employee's work activity and timesheet status.

**totalActiveTasks**: The count of open and in-progress tasks assigned to the employee.

**hoursLoggedThisWeek**: The total hours worked during the current week, calculated from all timelog entries. Shown as a decimal number (e.g., 37.5 for 37 hours 30 minutes).

**pendingTimesheets**: The count of timesheets in 'submitted' status awaiting approval. This helps the employee track their submission backlog.

All statistics are calculated in real-time and reflect the current state of the employee's work data.
statistics.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregations from multiple sources:
- totalActiveTasks: COUNT(hrm_time_track_tasks) WHERE employee.id = authenticated.id AND status IN ('open', 'in-progress') AND deleted_at IS NULL
- hoursLoggedThisWeek: SUM(duration_seconds) / 3600 FROM hrm_time_track_timelogs WHERE employee.id = authenticated.id AND date >= current week Monday AND date <= current week Sunday AND deleted_at IS NULL
- pendingTimesheets: COUNT(hrm_time_track_timesheets) WHERE employee.id = authenticated.id AND status = 'submitted' AND deleted_at IS NULL
All values are non-negative. Returns 0 for hoursLoggedThisWeek if no timelogs exist.

IHrmTimeTrackPersonalDashboard.description:
Personal dashboard data for authenticated employees showing work activities, time tracking, and project assignments.

The dashboard consolidates active tasks, recent timelogs, current timesheet status, project memberships, and summary statistics into a single view. All data is scoped to the employee's current organization context.

Dashboard components include:

**Active Tasks**: Open and in-progress tasks assigned to the employee, ordered by due date and priority.

**Recent Timelogs**: Time entries logged during the current week (Monday-Sunday).

**Current Timesheet**: The timesheet for the current week if it exists, including status and total hours.

**Project Memberships**: Active projects the employee is assigned to with their role.

**Statistics**: Summary metrics including total active tasks, hours logged this week, and pending timesheets.
IHrmTimeTrackPersonalDashboard.x-autobe-specification:
Computed dashboard aggregating data from multiple sources for the authenticated employee:

**Source Tables and JOINs**:
1. hrm_time_track_employees - authenticated employee from current organization context (JWT session)
2. hrm_time_track_tasks - JOIN on employee.id, filter status IN ('open', 'in-progress'), order by due_date ASC, priority DESC
3. hrm_time_track_timelogs - JOIN on employee.id, filter date >= current week Monday AND date <= current week Sunday
4. hrm_time_track_timesheets - LEFT JOIN on employee.id AND week_start_date = current week Monday (nullable)
5. hrm_time_track_project_members - JOIN on employee.id, filter project.status = 'active'

**Aggregation Formulas**:
- totalActiveTasks: COUNT of tasks with status IN ('open', 'in-progress') for the employee
- hoursLoggedThisWeek: SUM(duration_seconds) / 3600 for timelogs in current week
- pendingTimesheets: COUNT of timesheets with status = 'submitted' for current employee

**Business Rules**:
- All queries scoped to employee's current organization (from JWT session)
- currentTimesheet is null if no timesheet exists for current week
- Empty arrays returned if no active tasks, timelogs, or project memberships
- Statistics always included even if zero values

**Edge Cases**:
- No timesheet for current week: return null for currentTimesheet
- No active tasks: return empty array for activeTasks
- No timelogs this week: return empty array for recentTimelogs
- No project memberships: return empty array for projectMemberships

id.description:
Unique identifier for the department.

This UUID identifies the department within the organization and is used to reference the department in other system operations.
id.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_time_track_departments.id. Unique identifier for the department within the organization, retrieved from the department record.

name.description:
Name of the department.

The human-readable name used to identify the department in the organizational structure and user interfaces.
name.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_time_track_departments.name. The display name of the department retrieved from the department record.

description.description:
Optional description of the department.

Provides additional context about the department's purpose, responsibilities, and scope within the organization. May be null if no description has been provided.
description.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_time_track_departments.description. Nullable field containing additional information about the department's purpose and scope, retrieved from the department record.

employee_count.description:
Number of active employees assigned to this department.

This count includes only employees with active status (not soft-deleted) who are currently assigned to the department. The value is computed in real-time from the employee records and reflects the current workforce distribution.
employee_count.x-autobe-specification: Computed by COUNT(*) from hrm_time_track_employees where hrm_time_track_department_id matches the department id AND deleted_at IS NULL. Returns integer >= 0 representing the number of active employees assigned to this department.

children.description:
Nested child departments in the organizational hierarchy.

Contains an array of sub-departments that report to this department. Each child department includes its own statistics and may contain further nested children, enabling a complete multi-level organizational tree view. Empty array if this department has no sub-departments.
children.x-autobe-specification: Computed recursive array of IHrmTimeTrackDepartmentReport.IStatistic for all direct child departments. Built by querying hrm_time_track_departments where parent_department_id equals this department's id. Sorted alphabetically by name. Empty array if no child departments exist.

IHrmTimeTrackDepartmentReport.IStatistic.description:
Hierarchical department statistic containing department identification, employee count, and nested child departments for organizational analysis.

This type represents a single department in the organizational hierarchy with its associated employee statistics. Each department includes its unique identifier, name, optional description, and the count of active employees assigned to it. The children array contains nested department statistics for sub-departments, enabling a complete tree view of the organizational structure.

The hierarchical structure allows for multi-level department organization, where top-level departments contain their direct child departments, which in turn may contain their own children, forming a complete organizational tree.
IHrmTimeTrackDepartmentReport.IStatistic.x-autobe-specification:
Compute hierarchical department report from hrm_time_track_departments and hrm_time_track_employees tables.

1. Query hrm_time_track_departments for active departments (deleted_at IS NULL) belonging to the authenticated user's organization.
2. For each department, LEFT JOIN with hrm_time_track_employees and COUNT active employees (deleted_at IS NULL) where hrm_time_track_department_id matches.
3. Build hierarchical tree by joining departments with their parent using parent_department_id.
4. Include: id, name, description (nullable), employee_count (integer >= 0), children (recursive array).
5. Sort departments alphabetically by name within each parent level.
6. Return array of top-level departments (parent_department_id IS NULL) with nested children.

Edge cases: Empty departments have employee_count = 0. Departments with no children have empty children array.

value.description:
Array of permission codes granted to the member through their role assignment.

Each permission code represents a specific capability or access level within the organization. Valid permission codes include organization_management, employee_management, employee_viewing, project_management, project_viewing, time_management, timesheet_approval, time_viewing_all, and report_viewing.

The array may be empty if the member has no employee record in the organization, has no role assigned, or if their role has no permissions configured.
value.x-autobe-specification:
Computed array of permission codes from hrm_time_track_role_permissions table.

Computation logic:
1. Use member_id and organization_id from session to find employee record in hrm_time_track_employees
2. Get role_id from the employee record
3. Query hrm_time_track_role_permissions where role_id matches to get all permission_code values
4. Return array of permission strings

Data source: hrm_time_track_role_permissions.permission_code column, joined via hrm_time_track_employees.role_id and hrm_time_track_roles.id.

Null handling: Returns empty array if employee not found, role not assigned, or employee/role soft-deleted.

IHrmTimeTrackEffectivePermission.description:
Effective permissions granted to the current member through their role assignment within the organization.

This response contains an array of permission codes that determine what actions the member can perform within the organization. Permission codes control access to organization management, employee management, project management, time tracking, timesheet approval, and reporting features.

If the member has no employee record in the organization, has no role assigned, or if the employee or role is soft-deleted, an empty array is returned in the value property.
IHrmTimeTrackEffectivePermission.x-autobe-specification:
Computed response type aggregating permission codes from multiple database tables.

Data source computation:
1. Extract member_id and organization_id from the authenticated member's session token
2. Query hrm_time_track_employees table to find the employee record where member_id matches and organization_id matches
3. If no employee record exists or the record is soft-deleted (deleted_at is not null), return empty array
4. If the employee has no role assigned (role_id is null), return empty array
5. Query hrm_time_track_roles table to verify the role exists and is not soft-deleted
6. If the role is soft-deleted (deleted_at is not null), return empty array
7. Query hrm_time_track_role_permissions table to retrieve all permission_code values where role_id matches the employee's role_id
8. Return the array of permission codes in the 'value' property

Error conditions:
- No employee record for member in organization → empty array
- Employee has no role assigned → empty array
- Employee or role is soft-deleted → empty array
- Role has no permissions → empty array

role_id.description:
Unique identifier for the role within the organization.

This UUID identifies the specific role definition and is used to reference the role in employee assignments, permission grants, and other role-related operations.
role_id.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_time_track_roles.id. This is the primary key of the role record, retrieved from the base query on hrm_time_track_roles table where deleted_at IS NULL and filtered by current organization ID.

name.description:
Human-readable name of the role.

Role names are unique within an organization and are used to identify and display roles in the user interface. Examples include 'Administrator', 'Manager', 'Employee', 'Time Keeper'. The name should be descriptive and distinguishable from other roles in the same organization.
name.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_time_track_roles.name. Human-readable role name retrieved from the base query on hrm_time_track_roles table. Role names are unique within an organization.

is_builtin.description:
Indicates whether this is a built-in system role or a custom user-created role.

Built-in roles (true) are predefined by the system with standard permission sets and cannot be permanently deleted. Custom roles (false) are created by organization administrators and can be fully managed including deletion. This distinction helps prevent accidental removal of essential system roles while allowing flexibility for organization-specific needs.
is_builtin.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_time_track_roles.is_builtin. Boolean flag retrieved from the base query indicating whether this is a system-defined built-in role (true) or a user-created custom role (false).

description.description:
Detailed description of the role's purpose and intended use.

The description provides context about what the role is for and what permissions it typically grants. This helps administrators understand when to assign this role to employees. Descriptions can include information about the role's scope, typical use cases, and any special considerations. This field is optional and may be null.
description.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_time_track_roles.description. Optional text field retrieved from the base query providing context about the role's purpose and intended use. Can be null if no description is provided.

employee_count.description:
Number of active employees currently assigned to this role.

This count represents how many employees in the organization have this role assigned to them. It includes only active employees (not soft-deleted) and helps administrators understand the usage and distribution of each role across the organization.
employee_count.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: COUNT of hrm_time_track_employees WHERE hrm_time_track_role_id = role.id AND deleted_at IS NULL. This counts only active (non-deleted) employees assigned to this role within the current organization.

permission_count.description:

IHrmTimeTrackRoleReport.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation from hrm_time_track_roles joined with hrm_time_track_employees and hrm_time_track_role_permissions.

Query Logic:
1. Base query: SELECT from hrm_time_track_roles WHERE hrm_time_track_organization_id = {currentOrgId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
2. For each role, compute employee_count: LEFT JOIN hrm_time_track_employees ON hrm_time_track_role_id = roles.id AND employees.deleted_at IS NULL, then COUNT()
3. For each role, compute permission_count: LEFT JOIN hrm_time_track_role_permissions ON hrm_time_track_role_id = roles.id, then COUNT()
4. Return array of role objects with aggregated counts

Organization-scoped to the authenticated user's current organization context. Only active (non-deleted) roles are included in the report.
